item.title: MiMo-V2.6-Pro: a frontier-level agent planner for about $0.12 per 100 calls?
item.content:encoded: Its first-action results look unusually strong for the measured cost. One latency number keeps the verdict from being a simple yes. In our 100-case planner run, it produced 95 valid native tool calls, matched the benchmark's ideal tool on 44 cases, and cost $0.1246 for the full replay.

item.title: Qwen3.5 flash: latency king with a memory caveat
item.content:encoded: Sub-200ms first tokens across our region tests, but context adherence degrades past 32k. We measured recall drop-off on long transcripts and the inflection point is sharp.
